# aether_registry_cleanup_policies (Data Source)

Every cleanup policy of the organization's registry. Policies survive disabling the registry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) The cleanup policies, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `delete` or `protect`.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions an artifact must ALL satisfy. `value` is always rendered as a string (a stored number or boolean is converted); `op`/`value` are null when the policy has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies--conditions))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scheduler runs the policy.
- `id` (String) Cleanup policy UUID.
- `last_run_at` (String) Time of the last run (RFC 3339); null until the policy has run.
- `last_run_deleted` (Number) Artifacts deleted by the last run; null until the policy has run.
- `last_run_freed_bytes` (Number) Bytes freed by the last run; null until the policy has run.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `repo_scope` (Set of String) Repository globs; empty means all repositories.
- `schedule` (String) `nightly`, `weekly` or `manual`.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the policy was last written (RFC 3339); runs move it too.

<a id="nestedatt--policies--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `op` (String) Comparison operator; null when absent.
- `type` (String) `age`, `tag_count`, `tag_name` or `untagged`.
- `value` (String) Operand as a string; null when absent.
